chapters.summary: The author defines faith as the substance of things hoped for and the evidence of things not seen, then recounts the great cloud of witnesses who lived by faith. By faith Abel offered, by faith Noah built the ark, by faith Abraham obeyed, by faith Moses chose to suffer with the people of God, and all these obtained a good report through faith though they did not receive the promise.

chapters.summary: The author urges believers to run with patience the race set before them, looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of their faith, who endured the cross for the joy that was set before Him. He teaches that God chastens those He loves as a father disciplines his children, and warns that if the Israelites did not escape who refused him that spoke on earth, much less shall we escape if we turn away from Him who speaks from heaven.

chapters.summary: The author gives practical exhortations: let brotherly love continue, be hospitable to strangers, honor marriage, be content with what you have, and remember those who have taught you the word of God. He declares that Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever, and prays that the God of peace would make them perfect in every good work to do His will.
